svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a flat oxide surface is broken by the tops of three metal-filled holes: two reach the silicon of the active areas and one, shallower, the top of the wide stack in the middle. After it a thin purple film of even thickness covers the whole flat surface and the tops of the three plugs.

svg.text: Before: the polished surface with three plugs (step 100)
A titanium-nitride film is deposited over
the polished surface and the plug tops.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
